name: Twilight Princess (Dusklight)
description: Native PS5 port of Dusklight for Twilight Princess, based on the reverse-engineered GameCube reimplementation. Features native Vulkan rendering with a 4K output surface, capped 60 FPS frame interpolation, DualSense controls, PlayStation button prompts, save support and optional HD textures. Requires your own supported USA GameCube game dump; no game data, saves, keys or texture packs are included.
author: mshivam019
